name: vibegit
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && unset OPENAI_BASE_URL ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@example.com GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@example.com OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-dummy GOOGLE_API_KEY=dummy GEMINI_API_KEY=dummy $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -m 'not live'
notes: Python 3.11 (requires-python >=3.11; CI: uv python install 3.11 + uv sync --locked + uv run pytest -q). Setup exports the committed uv.lock (default deps + dev group) and installs it, then the package editable with --no-deps (re-pointed at the run copy by prepare()). test_cmd = the CI command (pytest -q) with -m 'not live': tests/test_pipeline.py is marked live (clones external repos and calls paid model APIs), so its 18 tests are deselected. Git identity env vars set because test_git commits into temp repos; HOME/TMPDIR sandboxed; dummy OpenAI/Gemini keys.
